definition: a soft shirt with short sleeves and no collar
exampleSentence: Lan was wearing jeans and a T-shirt.
exampleTranslation: Lan đang mặc quần jean và áo phông.

definition: a piece of clothing with a collar and buttons down the front
exampleSentence: I have to wear a shirt and tie to work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phải mặc áo sơ mi và thắt cà vạt đi làm.

definition: a shirt for women
translation: áo kiểu nữ, áo sơ mi nữ
exampleSentence: Lan wore a white silk blouse.
exampleTranslation: Lan mặc một chiếc áo kiểu lụa trắng.

definition: a warm piece of clothing with long sleeves, made of wool or cotton
exampleSentence: Put on a sweater, it is cold.
exampleTranslation: Mặc áo len vào đi, trời lạnh đấy.

definition: a piece of clothing made of wool that covers the top half of your body
translation: áo len chui đầu, áo len
exampleSentence: My grandmother knitted me a blue jumper.
exampleTranslation: Bà tôi đã đan cho tôi một chiếc áo len màu xanh.

definition: a loose jacket or top made of soft material, with a hood
translation: áo hoodie, áo nỉ có mũ
exampleSentence: I wear a hoodie when it is cool.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc áo hoodie khi trời mát.

definition: a sweater that fastens at the front with buttons or a zip
translation: áo len cài cúc, áo cardigan
exampleSentence: Take a cardigan in case it gets cold.
exampleTranslation: Hãy mang theo áo cardigan phòng khi trời lạnh.

definition: a short light coat
exampleSentence: I left my jacket on the chair.
exampleTranslation: Tôi để quên áo khoác trên ghế.

definition: a piece of clothing with long sleeves that you wear over other clothes to keep warm
exampleSentence: Put your coat on, it is cold outside.
exampleTranslation: Mặc áo khoác vào đi, bên ngoài lạnh đấy.

definition: a coat that you wear to keep off the rain
exampleSentence: Take your raincoat, it might rain.
exampleTranslation: Mang theo áo mưa đi, trời có thể mưa.

definition: a set of clothes of the same material, usually a jacket with trousers or a skirt
exampleSentence: I wore a dark suit to the interview.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc bộ com-lê tối màu đi phỏng vấn.

definition: a piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body and legs
exampleSentence: Lan wore a long red dress.
exampleTranslation: Lan mặc một chiếc váy liền dài màu đỏ.

definition: a piece of clothing that hangs down from the waist, worn by women and girls
exampleSentence: Your skirt is too short for school.
exampleTranslation: Chân váy của bạn quá ngắn để mặc đi học.

definition: a piece of clothing that covers your legs and has a separate part for each leg
exampleSentence: My trousers are too long.
exampleTranslation: Quần của tôi dài quá.

definition: trousers
exampleSentence: I wore dark blue pants and a white sweater.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc quần dài xanh đậm và áo len trắng.

definition: trousers made of denim, a strong blue cotton cloth
exampleSentence: I wear jeans almost every day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc quần jean hầu như ngày nào.

definition: short trousers that end at or above the knees
exampleSentence: It is hot, so I am wearing shorts.
exampleTranslation: Trời nóng nên tôi mặc quần short.

definition: tight trousers that stretch to fit the shape of your legs
exampleSentence: I wear leggings to yoga class.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc quần legging đi học yoga.

definition: thin tight clothing that covers the feet and legs up to the waist
exampleSentence: I need black tights for the party.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần một chiếc quần tất đen cho buổi tiệc.

definition: clothes that you wear next to your body under other clothes
exampleSentence: Remember to pack clean underwear.
exampleTranslation: Nhớ mang theo đồ lót sạch nhé.

definition: a short piece of underwear worn under trousers
exampleSentence: I bought three pairs of underpants.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua ba chiếc quần lót.

definition: a piece of underwear that a woman wears to support her breasts
exampleSentence: I need to buy a new bra.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần mua một chiếc áo ngực mới.

definition: a soft piece of clothing that you wear on your foot inside a shoe
exampleSentence: I can not find my other sock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không tìm thấy chiếc tất còn lại.

definition: soft trousers and a top that you wear in bed
exampleSentence: The children are already in their pyjamas.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đã mặc đồ ngủ rồi.

definition: a thin dress that a woman wears in bed
exampleSentence: I sleep in a cotton nightdress.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngủ trong một chiếc váy ngủ bằng vải cotton.

definition: a long loose coat that you wear at home over night clothes
translation: áo choàng mặc ở nhà, áo choàng ngủ
exampleSentence: I put on my dressing gown and made tea.
exampleTranslation: Tôi khoác áo choàng ngủ vào rồi pha trà.

definition: a piece of clothing that you wear for swimming
exampleSentence: Do not forget your swimsuit and towel.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên đồ bơi và khăn tắm nhé.

definition: special clothes worn by all the members of a group, such as a school
exampleSentence: Tom was still wearing his school uniform.
exampleTranslation: Tom vẫn đang mặc đồng phục học sinh.

definition: loose trousers and a jacket that you wear for sport
exampleSentence: I wear a tracksuit when I run.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc bộ đồ thể thao khi chạy bộ.

definition: a piece of clothing without sleeves, worn over a shirt
exampleSentence: Tom wore a waistcoat under his jacket.
exampleTranslation: Tom mặc áo gi-lê bên trong áo khoác.

definition: one-piece clothes like a shirt and trousers, worn to protect other clothes
exampleSentence: The workers wear blue overalls.
exampleTranslation: Công nhân mặc đồ bảo hộ màu xanh.

definition: to have clothes, shoes or jewellery on your body
exampleSentence: I do not wear a hat in summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè tôi không đội mũ.

definition: to put a piece of clothing on your body
translation: mặc vào, đội vào, đeo vào
exampleSentence: Put on your shoes, we are leaving.
exampleTranslation: Xỏ giày vào đi, chúng ta sắp đi rồi.

definition: to remove a piece of clothing
exampleSentence: Please take off your shoes at the door.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy cởi giày ở cửa.

definition: to put on clothes to see if they fit or look good
exampleSentence: Can I try on this jacket?
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc thử chiếc áo khoác này được không?

definition: if clothes fit, they are the right size for your body
exampleSentence: These jeans do not fit me.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc quần jean này không vừa với tôi.

definition: to put your clothes on
exampleSentence: Get dressed, or we will be late.
exampleTranslation: Mặc quần áo đi, không thì chúng ta sẽ muộn.

definition: to take off your clothes
exampleSentence: I undressed and got into bed.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cởi quần áo rồi lên giường.

definition: to look good together because of a similar colour or pattern
exampleSentence: Your socks do not match.
exampleTranslation: Hai chiếc tất của bạn không giống nhau.

definition: tight clothes fit your body very closely, often in an uncomfortable way
exampleSentence: These shoes are too tight for me.
exampleTranslation: Đôi giày này chật quá với tôi.

definition: loose clothes are not tight on your body
exampleSentence: I like loose clothes in summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè tôi thích quần áo rộng.

definition: cloth or thread made from the cotton plant
exampleSentence: This is a white cotton shirt.
exampleTranslation: Đây là một chiếc áo sơ mi cotton màu trắng.

definition: a thin smooth soft cloth made from thread produced by a silkworm
exampleSentence: My scarf is made of silk.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc khăn của tôi làm bằng lụa.

definition: material made from the soft thick hair of sheep
exampleSentence: This sweater is made of wool.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc áo này làm bằng len.

definition: animal skin that is used to make shoes, bags and clothes
exampleSentence: I bought a black leather jacket.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một chiếc áo khoác da màu đen.

definition: a strong cotton cloth used to make jeans
translation: vải denim, vải bò, vải jean
exampleSentence: I wore a denim jacket.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc một chiếc áo khoác denim.

definition: the part of a piece of clothing that covers your arm
exampleSentence: This dress has long sleeves.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc váy này có tay dài.

definition: the part of a shirt or coat that goes around your neck
exampleSentence: My shirt has a white collar.
exampleTranslation: Áo sơ mi của tôi có cổ màu trắng.

definition: a small bag sewn into a coat or trousers for keys, money and so on
exampleSentence: I put my keys in my pocket.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bỏ chìa khóa vào túi quần.

definition: a small round object on a shirt or coat that you pass through a hole to fasten it
translation: cúc áo, khuy áo, nút áo
exampleSentence: A button fell off my shirt.
exampleTranslation: Một chiếc cúc áo của tôi bị rơi.

definition: two lines of metal or plastic pieces that slide together to fasten clothes
exampleSentence: The zip on my skirt is broken.
exampleTranslation: Khóa kéo của chân váy tôi bị hỏng.

definition: one of a set of standard measures for clothes and shoes
exampleSentence: Do you have this shirt in a bigger size?
exampleTranslation: Cửa hàng có chiếc áo này cỡ lớn hơn không?

definition: a style of clothes that is popular at a particular time
exampleSentence: I am very interested in fashion.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất quan tâm đến thời trang.

definition: the things that people wear to cover their body
exampleSentence: I need to buy some new clothes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần mua quần áo mới.

definition: clothes worn to look like someone or something else, for example at a party
translation: trang phục biểu diễn, đồ hóa trang
exampleSentence: I wore a witch costume to the party.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc đồ hóa trang phù thủy đến bữa tiệc.

definition: a jacket, sometimes with the sign of a school or club on it
exampleSentence: Tom wore a blue blazer to school.
exampleTranslation: Tom mặc áo blazer xanh đi học.

definition: a shirt with a collar and a few buttons at the neck, pulled on over the head
translation: áo polo, áo thun có cổ
exampleSentence: I bought a red polo shirt.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một chiếc áo polo màu đỏ.

definition: a piece of clothing like a T-shirt but with no sleeves
translation: áo ba lỗ, áo tank top
exampleSentence: I wear a tank top when it is hot.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc áo ba lỗ khi trời nóng.

definition: a loose warm piece of clothing for the top half of your body, worn for sport or relaxing
exampleSentence: I put on a grey sweatshirt.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc một chiếc áo nỉ màu xám.

definition: a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head to keep warm
exampleSentence: I wore a long wool scarf.
exampleTranslation: Tôi quàng một chiếc khăn len dài.

definition: a piece of clothing that you wear on your hand to keep it warm
exampleSentence: I lost one of my gloves.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị mất một chiếc găng tay.

definition: a piece of clothing that you wear on your head
exampleSentence: Lan was wearing a beautiful new hat.
exampleTranslation: Lan đang đội một chiếc mũ mới rất đẹp.

definition: a flat hat with a curved part sticking out at the front
translation: mũ lưỡi trai, nón lưỡi trai
exampleSentence: Tom always wears a baseball cap.
exampleTranslation: Tom lúc nào cũng đội mũ lưỡi trai.

definition: a long narrow piece of cloth tied in a knot around the neck
exampleSentence: I wear a shirt and tie at work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc áo sơ mi và thắt cà vạt đi làm.

definition: a short piece of cloth tied in the shape of a bow at the neck
exampleSentence: Tom wore a black bow tie to the wedding.
exampleTranslation: Tom thắt nơ đen đến đám cưới.

definition: a long line of colour, often one of several close together
exampleSentence: I like shirts with blue and white stripes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích áo sơ mi sọc xanh trắng.

definition: a repeated arrangement of shapes or colours on cloth or other things
exampleSentence: The curtains have a flower pattern.
exampleTranslation: Rèm cửa có họa tiết hoa.

definition: a pattern of squares, especially on cloth
translation: họa tiết ca rô, ô vuông
exampleSentence: I like shirts with red and white checks.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích áo sơ mi ca rô đỏ trắng.

definition: without any pattern or decoration
exampleSentence: I prefer a plain white T-shirt.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích áo phông trắng trơn hơn.

definition: popular at the present time
exampleSentence: Bright colours are very fashionable this year.
exampleTranslation: Màu sáng rất hợp thời trang năm nay.

definition: not modern or fashionable any more
exampleSentence: Lan wears really old-fashioned clothes.
exampleTranslation: Lan mặc quần áo rất lỗi thời.

definition: casual clothes are not formal and are comfortable to wear
exampleSentence: Casual clothes are fine for the picnic.
exampleTranslation: Mặc đồ thường ngày đi dã ngoại là được.

definition: formal clothes are worn for important or official events
exampleSentence: I need formal clothes for the wedding.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần quần áo trang trọng cho đám cưới.

definition: to bend cloth or paper so that one part lies over another
exampleSentence: Please fold your clothes and put them away.
exampleTranslation: Hãy gấp quần áo lại rồi cất đi.

definition: to hang clothes on a hook or hanger
exampleSentence: Hang up your coat when you come in.
exampleTranslation: Vào nhà thì treo áo khoác lên nhé.

definition: to make clothes or other things dry
exampleSentence: I dry my clothes outside in summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè tôi phơi quần áo ngoài trời.

definition: a mark on clothes that is difficult to remove
exampleSentence: There is a coffee stain on my shirt.
exampleTranslation: Có một vết cà phê trên áo sơ mi của tôi.

definition: a piece of cloth or paper on something that gives information about it
exampleSentence: Read the label to see how to wash it.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đọc nhãn để biết cách giặt.

definition: cloth used for making clothes and curtains
exampleSentence: This fabric feels soft and light.
exampleTranslation: Loại vải này mềm và nhẹ.

definition: cloth used for making clothes and curtains
exampleSentence: What material is this dress made of?
exampleTranslation: Chiếc váy này làm bằng chất liệu gì?

definition: a set of clothes worn together, especially for a special occasion
exampleSentence: I bought a new outfit for the party.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một bộ đồ mới cho bữa tiệc.

definition: a two-piece set of clothes that women wear for swimming
translation: bộ bikini, đồ bơi hai mảnh
exampleSentence: I packed a bikini for the beach.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã đóng gói một bộ bikini để đi biển.

definition: short trousers that men and boys wear for swimming
exampleSentence: I forgot my swimming trunks.
exampleTranslation: Tôi quên mang quần bơi rồi.

definition: a part of a coat that you can pull up to cover your head
exampleSentence: Put your hood up, it is raining.
exampleTranslation: Đội mũ trùm đầu lên đi, trời đang mưa.

definition: to use a needle and thread to make or repair clothes
exampleSentence: Can you sew a button on this shirt?
exampleTranslation: Bạn khâu giúp tôi một chiếc cúc lên áo này được không?

definition: two things of the same type that are used together, or an object with two parts
exampleSentence: I bought a new pair of jeans.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một chiếc quần jean mới.

definition: to wear special or more formal clothes
translation: ăn diện, mặc đồ đẹp, hóa trang
exampleSentence: You do not have to dress up for the party.
exampleTranslation: Bạn không cần phải ăn diện cho bữa tiệc đâu.

definition: attractive in a fashionable way
exampleSentence: You look very stylish in that jacket.
exampleTranslation: Bạn trông rất sành điệu trong chiếc áo khoác đó.

definition: baggy clothes are big and do not fit tightly
exampleSentence: I wore jeans and a baggy T-shirt.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc quần jean và áo phông rộng thùng thình.

definition: wearing neat, attractive clothes and looking tidy
translation: chỉnh tề, bảnh bao, lịch sự
exampleSentence: You look very smart today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay bạn trông rất chỉnh tề.

definition: a sleeveless shirt or dress has no sleeves
exampleSentence: I bought a sleeveless dress for summer.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một chiếc váy sát nách cho mùa hè.

definition: loose warm trousers worn for sport or relaxing
exampleSentence: I relax at home in sweatpants.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc quần nỉ khi thư giãn ở nhà.

definition: a long loose piece of clothing worn over night clothes or after a bath
exampleSentence: I put on a robe after my bath.
exampleTranslation: Tôi khoác áo choàng sau khi tắm.
